# Parley v0.1.22

This test beta is v0.1.21 plus the corrections that landed after it was cut.
The application behaves as v0.1.21 does, including its idle-polling
performance work; what changes is the in-app Help and the way releases are
published. It is the first release the GitLab pipeline publishes itself.

## Help

- The worktree section of Help names the real controls. The worktree browser
  opens from **Open Worktree…** in the Workspace menu; the previous text
  described a control that did not exist.
- Team templates are saved from **Save Current as Team Template…** in the
  Workspace menu or **Save as Team Template…** in a workspace's context menu;
  the workspace plus menu applies one under **From Team Template**.
- A Help audit check now pins the worktree promises against the code: one
  approved add under the repository's `.worktrees` directory, person-triggered
  removal and every refusal the cleanup policy can raise, the reviewed
  ignored-path limit, no `--force`, no branch deletion, no extra permission
  root, and the exact creation notice and Team Sessions disclosure.

## Release process

- Test betas are published as releases of the GitLab project, with their
  files in its generic package registry, by the manual `release-beta` job
  using the pipeline's own token. The retired GitHub Actions beta workflow is
  removed and the notarized GitHub workflow stays documented but disabled.
- The packaged install guide no longer names GitHub as the release host.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
